description: Ed25519 public keys used to sign the records of the Arcaeon witness case protocol (arcaeon-case/1): sealed cases, withdrawal records and reference rows are signed by a case key (role case, or no role), and the reconcile key that signs each sealed case's reconcile receipt is listed in this document too, with role reconcile. Each signed record names its key in signed_by, the key id <key name>+<8 hex>; find that key id here, in that role, and check the record's signature with the verifier string beside it. The signature is Ed25519 over the json-c14n:v1 bytes of the whole record minus sig. One public key is listed once, in one role: a case key is never the witness log's key or the reconcile key.
matching: Match on key_id, then use verifier: <key name>+<8 lowercase hex of sha256(name || 0x0a || 0x01 || public key)[0:4]>+<base64(0x01 || 32-byte Ed25519 public key)>, the signed-note verifier format of the witness log. key_id is the verifier without its base64 tail. Compare key bytes, not names.

status_meaning.active: currently used for signing in its role; trusted
status_meaning.retired: rotated out; cases it signed while current remain trusted
status_meaning.revoked: withdrawn because its private half is believed exposed: cases pinned before the revoking commit keep their verdict under a banner, and cases pinned at or after it do not verify. The revoking commit is the pins-repository commit that writes the key's revocation marker (see rotation); a sealed case is ordered against it by the commit its pin records, never by a date.

rotation: Rotation adds a new key with status active and moves the previous key to retired, so records signed before the rotation keep verifying. A key is marked revoked only if its private half is believed exposed; the revoked_since beside it is the operator's statement of the day, shown and never used to order anything. A revocation takes effect for a sealed case only when this document marks the key revoked and the pins repository holds the key's revocation marker, revocations/<fingerprint>.json (the fingerprint is the sha256 of the 32-byte public key, in hex), written once and never overwritten by tools/record_key_revocation.js, naming the key id, the fingerprint and the commit of this repository at which this document first lists the key revoked. A marker without that revocation here revokes nothing. A reader holds a sealed case to the document it names, at a commit on this repository's published branch, and each key that signed it must also be listed here, in its role, when the case is read. This document is the single place a key is announced. The service signs only with a key listed here as active in its role: it carries this document in its own deployment, checks the configured keys against it, and before it seals confirms that this document is the one at the commit it names.

keys.note: arcaeon witness case signing key, minted 2026-10-10 on the owner's laptop
